_meta.status: DRAFT by the main session from a first read; every entry must be re-checked, and the hook's mechanics (launch fee curve, cap decay, trim, wall) are still to add
_meta.format: key -> {text: words the docs print, value: raw on-chain value as a decimal string or null, chain: the site's constant key con(s, 'Contract.NAME') or null, format: int|imd|plea|duration|bps|multiplier|text, source: file:line, what: one line}

max_score.what: the judges' scale is 0 to 45; a need above 45 cannot pass (CannotPass)

oracle_fee.what: a plea's or an appeal's oracle fee, spent whatever the verdict

appeal_wall_share.what: an appeal's extra payment, to the buy wall

sell_window.what: time to sell after an approval

cooldown.what: after a sale, a denial or a lapse; also the appeal window after a denial (:379)

pending_expiry.what: a plea with no verdict after this can be expired by anyone

max_plea_bytes.what: a plea's text, in UTF-8 bytes (the number alone: a page writes the word bytes after it)

max_sell.what: most PLEA one plea may sell

max_share.what: most of the balance one plea may sell

min_share.source: src/CabalGate.sol:119; rule :525-532 (at least 1% of the balance, or 2.5M PLEA when that is less)
min_share.what: least share a plea may sell

deadman.what: the Cabal dies after this long without a signed plea verdict

fact_share_bands.text: selling at most 20%: 16 points; at most 35%: 9; more: 3
fact_share_bands.what: share-sold part of the fact score

fact_held_points.text: held under a day: 0; a day: 1; 3 days: 2; 7 days: 3
fact_held_points.what: holding-time part (from the buy record's average buy time)

fact_profit_bands.text: at a loss: 13; gain at most 50%: 12; at most 200%: 10; at most 500%: 8; at most 1,000%: 6; more: 4
fact_profit_bands.what: profit part (value of the recorded PLEA at the latest price vs the IMD spent)

fact_received.text: PLEA no buy record covers (airdrop, prizes) counts as held since trading opened, at profit 9

fact_trend.text: 24-hour price up more than 2%: 9; within 2% (or no price 24 hours ago): 5; down more than 2%: 0

judge_rubric.text: sincerity 0-12, craft 0-12, respect 0-9, loyalty 0-12; anchors 0-10 empty/abusive/off-topic, 11-25 sincere but plain, 26-35 specific and well made, 36-45 memorable

objection_window.what: time after an approval to object

objection_stake.what: back if sustained or void; to the season's prize pot if overruled (src/Tribunal.sol:40-49)

objection_margin.what: sustained when the new score is more than 2 below the need

max_objections.what: objections per plea, from different wallets

objection_expiry.what: an unanswered objection becomes void after this

min_points.what: points to qualify for a prize

shares.text: 4.50% for 1st down to 3.50% for 25th, in a straight line, 100% in all

close_grace.what: after a season ends, before it can be closed

bonus_seasons.what: seasons that also pay the PLEA bonus

bonus_per_season.what: PLEA bonus per season, same shares; unpaid shares are burned

seat_multiplier.what: points for an IMD seat holder at recording, rounded down

letter_share.what: a letter pleads 20% of the writer's PLEA (within the 2.5M cap)

runner_tip.what: paid to whoever delivers an approved letter or auto-sell plea; refunded when no sale happens

auto_sell_fee.what: taken from a delivered auto-sell sale, to the season's prize pot (letters do not pay it)

min_sale_value.what: a letter or auto-sell plea worth less at the snapshot is refused

max_fee_share.what: a letter's fees may take at most 10% of the writer's PLEA

fee_cap.what: the fee swap may spend at most the snapshot value of the IMD it buys, plus 10%

delivery_min_out.what: a delivered sale must get at least 95% of its snapshot value after the hook's sale fees

fee_cashback.what: back to the trader as sIMD (imd/acc's Stacker)

fee_prize.what: to the season's prize pot (to pool liquidity after the death: check)

fee_pool.what: to pool liquidity, the buy wall

launch_window.what: the launch window after trading opens

launch_extra.source: src/PleaHook.sol:81 (to pool liquidity; the formula is in the hook: check what it is a share of)
launch_extra.what: the launch fee at the open; it falls in a straight line to 0% over the launch window (the words are the page's)

launch_max_buy.what: most PLEA one buy may get in the launch window

market_cap.what: the market cap trading opens at

cap_decay_days.what: the cap ratchets to its floor over this

wall_guard.what: how far the wall may move up a day

supply_split.text: 82% to the pool (820,000,000), 6% to Seasons (60,000,000), 12% to the distributor (120,000,000)
supply_split.source: src/PLEA.sol (Initialized; 82/6/12 comment at src/PleaLaunch.sol:22); minted on chain at deployHook (HANDOFF)

start.what: from this time anyone may seed; the owner may seed earlier
